traceDiagram.title: Party page flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the party page loads the party through the `loadParty` thunk of `partySlice` and reads its open slots through `selectOpenSlots()`. It also shows what happens when the user releases a Pokemon, adds a suggestion or saves the party, and how each action reaches `partySlice` or the `saveParty` mutation of `pokemonApi`.

traceNodes.label: Renders the party page
traceNodes.description: When the user opens the app, [`main.tsx` renders this component](code:src/main.tsx#L13) inside the Redux `Provider`.

children.label: Shows the party, the suggestions and a Save button
children.description: When `App` renders, [it renders this page](code:src/App.tsx#L6). When the user clicks Release, the page dispatches `removeMember`. When the user clicks Add, the page dispatches `addMember`, and Save the party calls the `saveParty` mutation.

A user clicks Add on a suggestion
A user clicks Save the party

Calls useSavePartyMutation to get the function that saves the party
Loads the saved party after the first render
Renders the open slots, the party, the suggestions and a Save the party button

Renders an Add button for each suggested Pokemon

traceNodes.label: Keeps the party members and their load status
traceNodes.description: When the party page renders, [`useSelector()` reads this slice through `selectOpenSlots()`](code:src/pages/party/PartyPage.tsx#L9). When the user clicks Release or Add, the page dispatches `removeMember` or `addMember`, and [`store` runs the reducer of this slice](code:src/store/index.ts#L8).

children.label: Reads the load status of the party
children.description: When the party page renders, `useSelector()` calls `selectOpenSlots()`, and [`selectOpenSlots()` calls this selector](code:src/store/party-slice.ts#L54).

children.label: Requests the saved party from the API
children.description: When the party page first renders, [its effect dispatches `loadParty()`](code:src/pages/party/PartyPage.tsx#L15), and Redux Toolkit runs this thunk.

blockLabels.label: Fetches `/api/party` and throws when the status is not 2xx

children.label: Counts the open slots, or 0 while the party loads
children.description: When the party page renders, [`useSelector()` calls this selector](code:src/pages/party/PartyPage.tsx#L9).

blockLabels.label: Builds the count from the members and the status

children.label: Adds a Pokemon while the party is idle and not full
children.description: When the user clicks Add on a suggestion, [the page dispatches `addMember`](code:src/pages/party/PartyPage.tsx#L34), and the slice runs this reducer.

children.label: Stores the released Pokemon and the time of the release
children.description: When the user clicks Release, the page dispatches `removeMember`, and [the listener middleware runs this effect](code:src/store/party-slice.ts#L45-50) after the reducer.

children.label: Marks the party as failed
children.description: When `loadParty` throws, Redux Toolkit dispatches `loadParty.rejected`, and [the slice runs this case](code:src/store/party-slice.ts#L39-41).

children.label: Replaces the members with the loaded party
children.description: When `loadParty` returns the party, Redux Toolkit dispatches `loadParty.fulfilled`, and [the slice runs this case](code:src/store/party-slice.ts#L35-38).

children.label: Marks the party as loading
children.description: When the page dispatches `loadParty()`, Redux Toolkit dispatches `loadParty.pending` before the request, and [the slice runs this case](code:src/store/party-slice.ts#L32-34).

triggerLabels.label: A Pokemon is released from the party

blockLabels.label: Keeps whether the party is idle, loading or failed
